title: Kneserized Anticoncentration and Reverse Absorption for Graham's Rearrangement Conjecture
summary: We establish a Kneser-based anticoncentration estimate for uniform subset sums in composite cyclic groups. The estimate contains a periodic loss and is weaker than its prime-modulus counterpart. Nevertheless, together with known small- and large-set results, it proves that, for every fixed $t\geq2$ such that $\mathbb{Z}_t$ is strongly sequenceable and every sufficiently large prime $p$, every subset of $\mathbb{Z}_{tp}\setminus\{0\}$ has a valid ordering, thus establishing the analogue of Graham's rearrangement conjecture for this family of composite cyclic groups.
